title: Retrieval Debugging Lab
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of query normalization, empty retrieval, and chunk inspection, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in college-faq-chatbot-rag.
learning_objectives: Explain query normalization, empty retrieval, and chunk inspection in plain language and connect it to src/query_rewriter.py; scripts/evaluate_retrieval.py.
Trace one input through the retrieval debugging lab stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: query normalization, empty retrieval, and chunk inspection
practical_outcomes: Trace the retrieval debugging lab stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for query normalization, empty retrieval, and chunk inspection.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
